apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — headache + light sensitivity after hitting your head is concussion signs. Not something to train through. Skip bouldering and hangboard tonight, get checked by a clinician before any return to climbing.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No blackout doesn't rule it out — headache and light sensitivity after head impact are concussion signs on their own. Not my call to override. I'm not adding the hangboard block or keeping the session; see a clinician before any return to climbing.
